description: This file defines the TbRadarChart class, a specialized chart component for rendering radar charts within the Thingsboard platform. It includes methods for setting default configurations, preparing chart options, updating data series, and handling interactions.

classes.name: TbRadarChart
classes.description: A class extending TbLatestChart to implement radar chart functionality with customizable settings, data handling, and rendering logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TbRadarChart with context, settings, DOM element, renderer, translation service, and auto-resize option.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns the default radar chart settings.

methods.name: prepareLatestChartOption
methods.description: Prepares the chart options including axes, labels, series styles, and animation based on current settings.

methods.name: doUpdateSeriesData
methods.description: Updates the radar chart data series and indicators based on current data items.

methods.name: findMaxDataItem
methods.description: Finds the data item with the maximum value among the provided array.

methods.name: forceRedrawOnResize
methods.description: Indicates whether the chart should be redrawn on resize events.

methods.name: keyEnter
methods.description: Handles key enter events for data keys (empty implementation).

methods.name: keyLeave
methods.description: Handles key leave events for data keys (empty implementation).

methods.name: toggleKey
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of a data key and updates the series accordingly.
